prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 10 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 4 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a landscape 16:9 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One painted storyboard image contains ten equal landscape panels, read left to right in a four-column, three-row grid; the final two cells remain blank, with thin neutral gutters throughout. Kasun is a medium-height, lean red artist's mannequin, and Anudi is an average-height, slender blue artist's mannequin; their surfaces are smooth and their proportions remain consistent. The setting and props are realistic: rain-wet asphalt, concrete paving, open kerb drainage, weathered commercial buildings, a compact charcoal food three-wheeler with a dark canopy, metal serving shelf and covered food trays. Anudi's left hand holds an open navy umbrella at chest height, with the tan structured handbag hanging from her left forearm; her right hand receives and retains the large orange smartphone with its transparent case and three black rear camera lenses. Soft overcast early-morning light comes from the open road at camera right, with subdued amber shop practicals beneath the awnings, muted grey and beige surroundings, restrained green accents and controlled wet reflections. There is no lettering or graphic annotation anywhere, including shop surfaces and phone displays.

Geography: The road and narrow pavement run horizontally across the established view, with the open kerb drain between them. All cameras stand on the roadward side and look toward the pavement. The vending bay is screen left, where the food three-wheeler stands before a weathered shutter beneath the modest concrete building; Kasun stands immediately to its right, and Anudi stands farther screen right. Behind Anudi, a stained beige boundary wall has a recognisable pale-green rectangular section toward frame right. The pavement continues past that wall toward the screen-right departure route. The dark vending canopy remains the left-side landmark, and the pale-green wall section remains the right-side landmark; tighter views crop these features rather than reversing them. Every opening remains in the roadside zone, including the final wide before either person changes position.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Roadward side, looking across the kerb toward the two mannequins; standing head height, 50mm feel, waist-up two-shot with both sets of hands visible. Background: The food three-wheeler and dark canopy sit behind Kasun on frame left. The stained boundary wall and pale-green section extend behind Anudi on frame right; the departure route is outside the tight right edge. The red mannequin stands screen left with chest and head turned three-quarter toward screen right, extending the orange phone in its right hand between the two bodies. The blue mannequin stands screen right with chest and head turned three-quarter left, its open right palm immediately beneath the offered handset. Red's left hand hangs empty, while blue's left hand grips the umbrella shaft at chest height and the handbag hangs from that forearm. The navy canopy occupies the upper-right portion without obscuring either head.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Roadward master position, looking across the pavement; standing head height, 35mm feel, medium-wide framing to mid-thigh. Background: The complete serving side of the food three-wheeler is clearly visible on frame left, with its canopy, metal shelf and covered trays. The beige boundary wall and pale-green section remain frame right. The red mannequin stands left with chest and head directed three-quarter right toward blue, both empty hands lowered. The blue mannequin stands right with chest directed left and head angled left toward red and the visible business beyond. Blue holds the phone low in its right hand, with the orange back toward the camera, while its left hand supports the open umbrella and the handbag remains on its left forearm. The wider frame includes the wet pavement beneath both figures.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Same roadward position as shot 1; standing head height, 50mm feel, equal-scale waist-up two-shot. Background: The softly resolved food three-wheeler and canopy remain frame left behind Kasun. The beige wall and pale-green section remain frame right behind Anudi. The red mannequin stands screen left with chest and head turned three-quarter right toward blue, both hands empty at its sides. The blue mannequin stands screen right with chest and head turned three-quarter left toward red, holding the phone in its right hand at waist height. Blue's left hand stays around the umbrella shaft at chest height, with the handbag supported by the same forearm. The low handset sits between the two bodies rather than being extended for another handover.
PANEL 4 (row 1, column 4) — Roadward side, tightened toward Kasun without crossing the axis; standing head height, 75mm feel, chest-up medium close-up with space to screen right. Background: The dark vending canopy is softly visible on frame left, with a weathered shutter behind the torso. The pale-green wall landmark remains farther right, outside this crop. The red mannequin fills the left and central portions of the panel, its chest directed right toward Anudi outside frame. Its head is turned three-quarter screen right rather than square to the camera. Both arms descend naturally, with the empty hands below the lower edge. The softened canopy stays behind the left side of the head and shoulder.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 1) — Roadward side, directed toward Anudi; standing head height, 50mm feel, waist-up medium shot with the phone included. Background: The beige boundary wall fills the background, with its pale-green section toward frame right. The food three-wheeler remains outside the crop to frame left. The blue mannequin stands right of centre with chest and head turned three-quarter screen left toward Kasun outside frame. Its right hand holds the phone at its right hip, showing the orange back rather than the display. Its left hand grips the umbrella shaft at chest height, with the tan handbag on that forearm. The open navy canopy crosses the upper-right edge, leaving clear space in the direction of the turned head.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 2) — Slightly above standing head height on the roadward side, looking obliquely downward; 50mm feel, chest-up medium close-up with handset and head both clear. Background: The beige wall remains behind Anudi, and the pale-green section stays on frame right. The vending canopy remains outside the crop to frame left. The blue mannequin's chest remains angled screen left, with its head turned three-quarter left and tilted down toward the upright phone. Its right hand holds the handset just below its head, angled so the display is visible both to the mannequin and obliquely to the camera. The incoming-call screen contains simple coloured fields and call icons without writing or a photograph. Its left hand remains around the umbrella shaft at the lower edge of the composition.
PANEL 7 (row 2, column 3) — Roadward side at standing head height; 85mm feel, close-up filled by the head, right hand and handset. Background: Soft beige wall fills the left background, with a blurred portion of the pale-green wall section on frame right. The food three-wheeler stays outside the crop to frame left. The blue mannequin's head fills most of the panel in three-quarter view toward screen left, with the upper chest maintaining the same leftward orientation. Its right hand holds the phone firmly against the right side of its head, leaving the orange back and clear case visible. A narrow length of umbrella shaft remains near the right edge, while the left hand and handbag are below the crop.
PANEL 8 (row 2, column 4) — Same roadward setup as shots 1 and 3; standing head height, 50mm feel, waist-up two-shot. Background: The food three-wheeler and dark canopy return on frame left behind Kasun. The stained beige wall and pale-green section remain frame right behind Anudi. The red mannequin stands screen left, chest and head turned three-quarter right toward blue, with both empty hands lowered. The blue mannequin stands screen right, chest and head turned three-quarter left, holding the phone against the right side of its head. Blue's left hand holds the open umbrella at chest height, and the handbag rests on that forearm. Both remain in their established positions, with the handset still raised.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 1) — Same roadward two-shot setup; standing head height, 50mm feel, waist-up framing with the lowered phone visible. Background: The softly resolved food three-wheeler and canopy remain frame left. The boundary wall and pale-green section remain frame right. The red mannequin stands left with chest and head directed three-quarter right toward blue, both hands empty at its sides. The blue mannequin stands right with chest and head directed three-quarter left toward red, its right hand now holding the phone low at waist height. Its left hand keeps the umbrella upright at chest height, with the handbag supported by its left forearm. The space between the bodies remains clear above the lowered handset.
PANEL 10 (row 3, column 2) — Roadward master position used for shot 2, opened to full figures; standing head height, 35mm feel, wide horizontal composition. Background: The food three-wheeler, dark canopy and shutter occupy frame left. The beige boundary wall, pale-green section and uninterrupted pavement extend toward screen right, with the kerb drain crossing the foreground. The red mannequin stands full length on screen left beside the business, chest and head turned right toward blue and both empty hands lowered. The blue mannequin stands full length on screen right, still facing left toward red, with the phone in its right hand at waist height. Its left hand holds the open umbrella, and the handbag hangs from its left forearm. The open pavement continues horizontally beyond blue toward screen right, while the business remains immediately behind and left of red.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
